items.text: Players can no longer deploy structures while they are crafting, preventing accidental deployments during crafting actions.
Helicopters that are pooled now tick correctly on the client, fixing missing helicopter movement and interaction.
FPV drones now display a dynamic artificial horizon showing pitch and roll angles, giving pilots clearer flight feedback.
When looting, a safe‑pocket indicator is shown beside the loot container, helping players see where their inventory will go.
The Outpost location is now marked on the extraction map, making it easier to navigate to this extraction point.
Beached loot containers now use unique loot pools (tools, ammo/meds, food) and contain many crates but no high‑tier weapons, changing beach loot composition.
NPC service system overhaul adds profession‑based name prefixes/suffixes, voice mumbling, and smoother conversation movement.
Armour and restoration booths now have full kiosk structures, and dedicated UI panels for restoration, armour, and giga‑furnace services improve visual layout and access.
Canteen NPCs automatically refill their food supplies to 80%, ensuring they stay stocked.
Rentable NPC services with an armor slot and restoration garages are available at the Outpost, and players can run these services by talking directly to the attendant.
The giga furnace can be operated from a walk‑in counter and a new drop‑off service is available at Bandit Camp.
Free resident meals are now provided at the Apartment Complex.
Finished rental earnings are held for 48 hours and restoration pricing has been updated.
A new 40 mm Tracker Round grenade sticks to vehicles and structures, creates a map tracking marker for five minutes, and emits a beep and flashing LED.

2026-11-11.summary:
### Gameplay Rules
- Players can no longer deploy structures while they are crafting, preventing accidental deployments during crafting actions.

### Mobility

- When looting, a safe‑pocket indicator is shown beside the loot container, helping players see where their inventory will go.

### Map & Extraction
- The Outpost location is now marked on the extraction map, making it easier to navigate to this extraction point.

### Loot & Spawn
- Beached loot containers now use unique loot pools (tools, ammo/meds, food) and contain many crates but no high‑tier weapons, changing beach loot composition.

### NPC Services & AI
- NPC service system overhaul adds profession‑based name prefixes/suffixes, voice mumbling, and smoother conversation movement.
- Armour and restoration booths now have full kiosk structures, and dedicated UI panels for restoration, armour, and giga‑furnace services improve visual layout and access.
- Canteen NPCs automatically refill their food supplies to 80%, ensuring they stay stocked.
- Rentable NPC services with an armor slot and restoration garages are available at the Outpost, and players can run these services by talking directly to the attendant.
- The giga furnace can be operated from a walk‑in counter and a new drop‑off service is available at Bandit Camp.
- Free resident meals are now provided at the Apartment Complex.
- Finished rental earnings are held for 48 hours and restoration pricing has been updated.

### Weapons
- A new 40 mm Tracker Round grenade sticks to vehicles and structures, creates a map tracking marker for five minutes, and emits a beep and flashing LED.

items.text: Turret weapons now take damage when firing and can break, shutting off their laser and sparking.
A reload progress bar is displayed beside the weapon in shoulder‑camera view.

Grenade updates – 40 mm flare now uses road flare VFX, appears white, and self‑destructs if shot into the ground; 40 mm incendiary grenade receives new visual and sound effects, an updated icon, and rebalanced damage.
Scientists now correctly flank targets, fixing previous failures.
Extraction maps expanded with additional monuments and a new 3 km procedural map scene for raids.
Extracted loot is automatically banked in a stash and raiders are spawned at raid start.
New shipping containers can spawn on mainland coasts (jungle, arctic, desert); they require lock‑breaking to open, are rare (~1 per 100 players), and contain unique loot.
Tool cupboards now fill resources evenly, similar to furnaces, improving resource balance.
CCTV recordings now handle player death or dismount events without crashing playback.
Added a deployable trampoline prototype for players to place and use.
Added a “clear customisation” action for skinned arrows and introduced a deployable fletching jig (arrow customization station).
Introduced a new FPV drone and goggles system, with script fixes for SetFlag behavior and null reference errors.

Cargo containers are now codelocked; breaking them requires 1.5× the damage of a timed satchel, health UI appears only when looking at the lock, doors cannot be destroyed and must be opened after unlocking; one container includes a code note.
Conveyor belts now move up to 24 items per tick, increasing throughput.
Scrolling panels no longer flicker, providing a stable UI view while moving through inventories or menus.
Previously invisible building blocks are now visible, ensuring structures can be placed and seen correctly.

2026-11-10.summary:
### Combat & Weapon Systems
- Turret weapons now take damage when firing and can break, shutting off their laser and sparking.
- A reload progress bar is displayed beside the weapon in shoulder‑camera view.
- Grenade updates – 40 mm flare now uses road flare VFX, appears white, and self‑destructs if shot into the ground; 40 mm incendiary grenade receives new visual and sound effects, an updated icon, and rebalanced damage.

### AI & NPC Behavior
- Scientists now correctly flank targets, fixing previous failures.

### Raids & Extraction
- Extraction maps expanded with additional monuments and a new 3 km procedural map scene for raids.
- Extracted loot is automatically banked in a stash and raiders are spawned at raid start.

### World & Loot
- New shipping containers can spawn on mainland coasts (jungle, arctic, desert); they require lock‑breaking to open, are rare (~1 per 100 players), and contain unique loot.
- Tool cupboards now fill resources evenly, similar to furnaces, improving resource balance.
- CCTV recordings now handle player death or dismount events without crashing playback.

### Deployables & Crafting
- Added a deployable trampoline prototype for players to place and use.
- Added a “clear customisation” action for skinned arrows and introduced a deployable fletching jig (arrow customization station).
- Introduced a new FPV drone and goggles system, with script fixes for SetFlag behavior and null reference errors.

### Infrastructure & Systems
- Cargo containers are now codelocked; breaking them requires 1.5× the damage of a timed satchel, health UI appears only when looking at the lock, doors cannot be destroyed and must be opened after unlocking; one container includes a code note.
- Conveyor belts now move up to 24 items per tick, increasing throughput.

### UI & Visuals
- Scrolling panels no longer flicker, providing a stable UI view while moving through inventories or menus.
- Previously invisible building blocks are now visible, ensuring structures can be placed and seen correctly.

items.text: Fixed bugs that left players behind boats, caused sleeping, sinking boats, or duplicated/incorrect entities during server transfers.
Enabled exiting vehicles and crossing between seamless servers, adding full neighbor connections, server links, vehicle transfers, and client handling for smoother travel.
Rewrote the conveyor system to move a fixed amount of items per tick, speed up when outputs near full, and resume scans after multi‑tick transfers.
Fixed a UI bug where powered storage adaptors incorrectly displayed a power requirement message.
Added two Minicopter wrecks per map at monuments that can be repaired for gears, metal fragments, high‑quality metal, and a random tier‑2 modular car part.
Implemented BoatDockTrigger on all fishing village docks, preventing vehicles from getting stuck and gently pulling them to the centre of water docks.
Fixed AK rifle stacking display so a stack correctly shows 20 AKs instead of an erroneous label.
Added a toggle to keep mouse sensitivity consistent across all weapons.
Added an ammo indicator to the 40 mm Flashbang grenade.

Introduced a major expansion to the experimental Rust XCOM mode, adding proper weapon handling, new enemy types, ladders, doors, manual furnace, full armoury with loadouts, melee options, overwatch, research, crafting, bases, terrain changes, camera controls, combat animations, cover improvements, loot drops, persistent squads, resource economy, repeatable raids, battle camera, and many other gameplay systems.
Fixed a crash caused by a NullReferenceException in the Wire Tool preview, preventing crashes and missing wire previews.

Cargo ship interior loot is now secured inside seven shipping containers; players must break them open (explosives/melee) to access loot, with one empty and one unlocked container containing brown crates.

2026-11-09.summary:
### Seamless Server Travel
- Fixed bugs that left players behind boats, caused sleeping, sinking boats, or duplicated/incorrect entities during server transfers.
- Enabled exiting vehicles and crossing between seamless servers, adding full neighbor connections, server links, vehicle transfers, and client handling for smoother travel.

### Base Building & Logistics
- Rewrote the conveyor system to move a fixed amount of items per tick, speed up when outputs near full, and resume scans after multi‑tick transfers.
- Fixed a UI bug where powered storage adaptors incorrectly displayed a power requirement message.

### World Content
- Added two Minicopter wrecks per map at monuments that can be repaired for gears, metal fragments, high‑quality metal, and a random tier‑2 modular car part.
- Implemented BoatDockTrigger on all fishing village docks, preventing vehicles from getting stuck and gently pulling them to the centre of water docks.

### Inventory & Combat
- Fixed AK rifle stacking display so a stack correctly shows 20 AKs instead of an erroneous label.
- Added a toggle to keep mouse sensitivity consistent across all weapons.
- Added an ammo indicator to the 40 mm Flashbang grenade.

### XCOM Mode Overhaul
- Introduced a major expansion to the experimental Rust XCOM mode, adding proper weapon handling, new enemy types, ladders, doors, manual furnace, full armoury with loadouts, melee options, overwatch, research, crafting, bases, terrain changes, camera controls, combat animations, cover improvements, loot drops, persistent squads, resource economy, repeatable raids, battle camera, and many other gameplay systems.

### Tools & Building
- Fixed a crash caused by a NullReferenceException in the Wire Tool preview, preventing crashes and missing wire previews.

### Loot & Exploration
- Cargo ship interior loot is now secured inside seven shipping containers; players must break them open (explosives/melee) to access loot, with one empty and one unlocked container containing brown crates.
